notes: Teach Pack the rest yourself. Library › Learn From Your Packs… lists your gigs' trucks: tick the ones you packed for real and finished, and Pack the rest follows them straight away: their stacks and rack columns, which cases share a row, what only goes by the doors, and the order from the nose. Load outs count for the stacks (their order is the strike order, so it's left out). Until now that took Claude and a script. Back to the built-in learning undoes it. A case you stack on its own kind goes two high, even above the row. Pack the rest kept every stack level with the row, so the ST12s you…
